content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal provide robust payment processing solutions but are limited by geographical restrictions that exclude many creators in countries like Nigeria. These options typically feature easy integration, multi-currency support, and instant settlement times, but they come at the cost of exclusion for those needing them most. On the other hand, sovereign commerce solutions, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, offer complete ownership of your online store, enabling you to sell digital products directly without being reliant on third-party processors. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you gain access to a comprehensive set of tools designed for creators, making it easier to deploy an effective sales platform without the typical limitations imposed by conventional payment processors.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture involves considering both your immediate needs and long-term goals. If you're just beginning and need a quick setup, mainstream options may seem enticing, but their limitations will quickly become apparent. For those who recognize the importance of sovereignty and control, the Edge Commerce Stack is the ideal choice. This architecture not only allows immediate deployment but also provides the tools necessary for future scaling. By investing in this infrastructure, you are not just solving a current problem; you are setting the foundation for a more resilient online business that can withstand market fluctuations and regulatory challenges, empowering you to focus on what matters: creating and selling.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Gain total ownership of your digital commerce.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

For digital creators in Nigeria who cannot access traditional payment processors, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear winner. It provides complete ownership, automated processes, and cost-effective transactions without the limitations imposed by platforms like Stripe and PayPal. The Edge Commerce Stack offers a robust solution that not only fits current needs but also anticipates future growth, making it an essential choice for anyone serious about their online business.
Automate your payment processing with ease.

The Edge Commerce Stack, priced at $197, is designed specifically for creators needing a reliable and autonomous way to sell digital products. This stack combines essential tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, ensuring you retain full control over your store, transactions, and customer interactions, setting you up for long-term success.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for the Edge Commerce Stack and gain access to necessary tools. 2. Deploy your online store using Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 3. Set up Cloudflare Workers to manage backend logic seamlessly. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic cryptocurrency payment processing. 5. Upload your digital products and configure delivery methods. 6. Test the entire system to ensure payment verification and product delivery work as expected. 7. Launch your store and promote it to your audience, knowing you own everything.

Why should I choose sovereign commerce over traditional platforms?

Sovereign commerce provides a permanent solution that bypasses geographical restrictions, ensuring that your online store remains operational and profitable regardless of changes in payment processing policies.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, with the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll receive 30 days of support to help you navigate any issues and ensure your online store is fully operational.
